name: CJIS Markings High Confidence
description: Explicit CJIS / CHRI / LES banner or portion markings — high-confidence indicator that the content is CJI regardless of payload.
expression: ((D:CJIS Marking Pattern (High Confidence) > 0) OR (D:Law Enforcement Sensitive (LES) Markings > 0))

name: CJIS Markings Medium Confidence
description: Looser CJIS keyword match — pairs with content indicators in other engines to cut false positives from casual mentions.

name: CJIS Identifier Engine
description: Structured CJIS identifiers — NCIC ORI, FBI UCN, State ID, NCIC Purpose Code. Any of these appearing in content is a strong signal.
expression: ((D:NCIC ORI Pattern > 0) OR (D:FBI UCN - Universal Control Number > 0) OR (D:State ID Number (SID) Reference > 0) OR (D:NCIC Purpose Code Pattern > 0))

name: Criminal History - RAP Sheet Engine
description: RAP-sheet / criminal-history terminology correlated with subject PII (SSN, DL, or DOB) within 500 chars. Suppresses matches on news articles that casually mention arrests.
expression: ((D:Criminal History - RAP Sheet Phrases > 0) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Drivers License (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Date of Birth - CJIS Prox 500 > 0)))

name: NCIC - III Data Engine
description: NCIC or III query/response terminology correlated with subject PII — indicates a live CJI data transfer.
expression: ((D:NCIC - III Query Terminology > 0) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Drivers License (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Date of Birth - CJIS Prox 500 > 0)))

name: Warrant - Wanted-Person Engine
description: Warrant/wanted terminology near subject PII — extradition, bench, arrest warrants referencing a named subject.
expression: ((D:Warrant - Wanted-Person Phrases > 0) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Drivers License (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Date of Birth - CJIS Prox 500 > 0)))

name: Biometric CJI Engine
description: Biometric identifiers (fingerprint, palm, AFIS, NGI) with CJIS markings or any structured CJIS identifier — indicates fingerprint card or biometric record.
expression: ((D:Biometric - AFIS Terminology > 0) AND ((D:CJIS Marking Pattern (High Confidence) > 0) OR (D:NCIC ORI Pattern > 0) OR (D:FBI UCN - Universal Control Number > 0)))

name: NICS Firearms Background Engine
description: NICS / firearm background-check terminology — ATF Form 4473, NICS denial, prohibited-person language.

name: Info-Sharing Portal Engine
description: Exfil of N-DEx, LEEP, or Nlets derived content references — info-sharing-system terminology co-occurring with subject identifiers.
expression: ((D:N-DEx - Criminal-Justice Info Sharing > 0) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:NCIC ORI Pattern > 0) OR (D:FBI UCN - Universal Control Number > 0)))

name: CJIS Any-Signal Engine
description: Any strong CJIS signal — explicit markings, structured identifiers, or RAP/NCIC/warrant content engines. Catch-all for broad monitoring.
expression: ((D:CJIS Marking Pattern (High Confidence) > 0) OR (D:Law Enforcement Sensitive (LES) Markings > 0) OR (D:NCIC ORI Pattern > 0) OR (D:FBI UCN - Universal Control Number > 0) OR (D:NCIC Purpose Code Pattern > 0))

name: CJIS US PII
description: From the Fed pack's US PII engine. Identity data of subjects, victims, witnesses and officers outside any CJI marking: five or more SSNs, TINs or alien registration numbers at high confidence, any one within 500 bytes of its label, or a date of birth with five or more driver's licence numbers.
expression: ((D:CJIS-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - CJIS Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:CJIS-Tax Identification Number (US) - High > 4) OR (D:CJIS-Tax Identification Number (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:CJIS-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:CJIS-Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0) OR ((D:CJIS-Date of Birth - High Confidence > 1) AND (D:CJIS-Drivers License (United States) - High > 4)))

name: CJIS TLP Red
description: From the Fed pack. Traffic Light Protocol RED marking: information for the named recipients only, shared under FBI, fusion-centre and ISAC agreements.

name: CJIS TLP Amber Strict
description: From the Fed pack. TLP:AMBER+STRICT marking: limited to the recipient organisation.

name: CJIS TLP Amber
description: From the Fed pack. TLP:AMBER marking: limited to the recipient organisation and its clients on a need-to-know basis.
